image_prompt: A whimsical, surreal scene where a giant, antique pocket watch is literally 'marking' time by drawing numbers on a blackboard with a tiny, anthropomorphic chalk stick. The short sentence 'O relógio marca as horas' is elegantly integrated into the blackboard's border, appearing as if written by the chalk stick itself. The background is a soft-focus, dreamy sky with subtle clockwork gears floating. High detail, vibrant colors, magical realism style.
caption: Às vezes, as maiores verdades são as mais simples! 🕰️ Quem mais fica hipnotizado pelo tic-tac do tempo? #ObvioMasNemTanto #TempoQueVoa #VerdadesDaVida #Relogio
